sentence: This project builds a deep learning tool that uses health records, genomics and surveys to find people at high risk of getting HIV.
This project uses directed evolution and machine learning to make miniature CRISPR systems work better as genome-editing tools that are easier to deliver.
This project tests whether restoring damaged blood vessel signals for blood stem cells can prevent blood system failure and leukemia after acute radiation injury.
This project tests whether genetically-engineered Bifidobacterium that delivers a human protein can help radiotherapy and immunotherapy treat pancreatic cancer.
This project provides mass spectrometry, data analysis and biomarker measurement services to measure chemical exposures in human urine, blood or DNA.
This project tests whether outreach by text, mailings and patient navigation can raise screening for breast, cervical, lung and colorectal cancer in primary care clinics.
This project tries to find out how each telomere in yeast ends up with its own distinct length.
This project develops medical imaging technology that measures brain growth in fetuses and neonates and tells normal growth from abnormal growth.
This project creates a tissue repository and a single-nucleus RNA sequencing atlas of heart and blood vessels from participants to study cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how psychosocial stress affects the body's immune and nervous systems and plaque in the arteries of people living with HIV.
This project builds software tools that use wearable data to predict early which hospitalized patients are getting worse.
This project uses machine learning and input from stakeholders to develop quality measures for how primary care providers treat attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder in children.
This project studies how binge-like alcohol drinking in mice changes somatostatin signaling from the prefrontal cortex to the periaqueductal grey.
This project studies how cannabis use relates to HIV prevention behaviors and to biological vulnerability to HIV infection.
This project develops switchable fluorescent probes that let researchers image several molecules and their surroundings in live cells at once.
This project studies how key membrane proteins that relate to beta-amyloid plaques are regulated in Alzheimer's disease, using structural, biophysical and functional techniques.
This project tests whether signaling in scarred lung tissue drives fibrosis in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis by harming lung cell renewal and activating fibroblasts.
This project builds a system that converts electronic health records and uses machine learning to study how multiple chronic diseases affect Alzheimer's disease.
This project uses artificial intelligence to measure sidewalks and lighting in rural communities and studies how they link to physical activity.
This project studies the immune features and genetic risk behind diabetes caused by immune checkpoint inhibitor cancer drugs, to learn how beta-cells are destroyed.
